info.name: kOmudIDAtukramANkaH
info.value: 9.21 SF ityasya ayam uBayapadI pAWaBedaH sidDAntakOmudyAM nAsti parantu kzIrataraNgiRyAM pAWitaH dfSyate .

examples: 'parA SfRIhi tapasA yAtuDAnAn parA'gne rakzo harasA SfRIhi. parArcizA muradevAY CfRIhi parAsutfpaH SoSucataH SfRIhi' (aTarva॰8.3.13).. iha sarvatra parASabdo viSaraRasya hiMsanasya kArtsnyamAha.
'parASfRItamacito nyozatam' (f॰7.104.1). ukto'rTaH.  parASara ityfzinAmaDeyam. atrApi paretyupasargaH. parASfRAtIti parASaraH. pacAdyac.
'indro vo'dya parASarIt' (aTarva॰3.66.2). parASarIditi luNi rUpam. vfdDyaBAvaSCAndasaH.
'sa ᳫ hEna ᳫ SfRAti' (Sa0 brA0 1.1.1.18). samyag hinastItyarTaH.
'tamaBipadya treDA samaSfRan' (jE0 brA0 1.97). samaSfRan vyaSasan, vyakfntan.
'saM vE gururBAH SfRAti' (E0 brA0 4.13). saMSfRAti hinasti. kziRoti.
'sarvezAM mUrDni vA tizWet viSIryeta vane'TavA' (hitopa0 1.113). viSIryeta mlAnaM sadaDaH patet.
'mA taRqulaM viSarIrdevayantam' (aTarva0 12.3.18). mA viSarIH=mA viSArIH. mA KaRqaSaH kArzIrityarTaH.
'ni SfRIhyAbADaM yo no asti' (tE0 brA0 2.4.7.3). nitarAM SIrRaM kuru.
